name: 5-qubit QFT matrix construction
task_prompt: Construct the 5-qubit QFT matrix directly from omega**(j*k)/sqrt(N) and also by multiplying embedded H, controlled-phase, and SWAP matrices in a declared endian convention. Align global phase, compare both matrices, verify unitarity and inverse round trip, and test the image of basis state |1>. Provide only complete executable Python code. Do not use remote services. Seed random generators, print the requested quantities, and include robust self-tests rather than relying on visual inspection.
